name: Raptor Mastery
summary: Deep in Stranglethorn Vale, Hemet Nesingwary challenges seasoned trackers to bring down an elusive predator that has escaped even him. Having proven your mettle against lesser beasts, you are tasked with tracking the cunning raptor known as Tethis and securing its talon.

sections.title: The Wily Predator of the Vale
sections.body: Following your earlier trials in the jungle, Hemet Nesingwary reveals the existence of a particularly vicious raptor named Tethis. While lesser hunters have chased prey across the foliage, Tethis has evaded capture entirely, defying even the expedition leader himself. Ajeck Rouack bestowed the beast with its moniker, marking it as the ultimate prize among Stranglethorn's scaled horrors.

sections.title: Claiming the Talon
sections.body: To stand recognized as a premier big game hunter, you are directed to prowl the grounds north of the Gurubashi Arena where Tethis is known to roam. Bringing back a talon from the slain terror will earn you the title of master raptor slayer, a feat no other big game hunter has accomplished.

faq.q: Who sends you to hunt Tethis?
faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary directs the hunt from his expedition encampment in northern Stranglethorn Vale after you prove your tracking capabilities against ordinary jungle raptors.
The ferocious beast prowls the jungle wilderness surrounding the Gurubashi Arena, most frequently sighted through the brush to the north of the colosseum.

faq.q: What proof does Hemet require of the kill?
faq.answer: Hemet requires the talon of Tethis as undeniable proof that the cunning creature has finally been brought down.

faq.q: Who originally named the raptor Tethis?
faq.answer: Ajeck Rouack, one of the hunters at Nesingwary's expedition camp, bestowed the elusive predator with the name Tethis.
